transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello, doctor. I’ve been taking on way too many projects at once and can’t seem to slow myself down at work or at home. It has gotten to a point where it's causing some real issues, so my sister and my manager strongly urged me to come in.
Have you always been this energetic and busy since you were a child, or is this a relatively new change from your normal self?

No, this is definitely a recent change that started about a month ago when a big restructuring project kicked off at work. Normally, I'm disciplined and creative, but lately I feel like a completely different person—totally revved up, overcommitted, and unable to slow myself down.
Have you ever had periods in the past where you felt the opposite—very down, depressed, and low on energy—or other times when you felt this unusually high energy?

No, I don't recall ever having times where I felt really down, depressed, or low on energy in the past. This current level of intense, out-of-control energy is completely unprecedented for me. I've never experienced anything like this before now.

Even if it wasn't as intense as what you are experiencing now, have you ever had milder periods in the past where you felt unusually cheerful, active, or needed much less sleep for at least a few days?
No, I haven't really experienced milder periods like that in the past. This is truly the first time I've ever felt this wired or active, even on a smaller scale.
How has your sleep been over the past month? Do you find yourself sleeping much less than usual but still waking up feeling fully rested and energized?

Yes, I've been sleeping much less than usual over the past month, sometimes only a few hours a night. I've been staying up late to keep up with all my work projects and evening workshops, feeling like I could finally do everything at once. Even with very little sleep, I wake up feeling completely wired and ready to go.
Have you noticed your thoughts racing or moving much faster than usual, as if you can't keep up with them?

Yes, my thoughts have been racing incredibly fast lately. I feel this constant pressure to keep talking and explaining my ideas because my mind is moving way faster than my mouth can keep up. It makes me jump from one big idea to the next so quickly that other people can barely follow what I'm saying.
Have you started any new medications, over-the-counter supplements, or used any stimulants (like ADHD medications, energy drinks, or other substances) around the time this started?
No, I haven't started any new medications or over-the-counter supplements recently. I also haven't been using any stimulants, energy drinks, or other substances around the time this all began.
Have you recently been diagnosed with any new medical conditions, or have you experienced any physical symptoms like thyroid issues, neurological changes, or head injuries?
No, I haven't been diagnosed with any new medical conditions recently. I also haven't experienced any thyroid issues, neurological changes, or head injuries.
Have you recently noticed hearing or seeing things that others can't, or felt like you have special powers or a unique mission that others might find hard to believe?
No, I haven't seen or heard anything unusual like that. I also don't believe I have any special powers or a unique mission, even though I've been feeling incredibly driven lately.
